Neuron output (single perceptron with tanh activation)
derived_values.used_by: Entry signal condition (out<0 for buy, out>0 for sell)

other_exits: SL and TP only - no signal-based close logic; opposite signal does not close existing position

custom_logic_notes: Single-layer perceptron (14 inputs, 14 weights) with tanh activation. Even-indexed inputs are normalized (Upper-Lower)/Base band ratios from 7 Bollinger Band bars. Odd-indexed inputs remain at default 0.0 (never assigned), effectively making them zero inputs. Weights are hardcoded via EA input parameters (w0-w13). NET is multiplied by 2 before tanh activation. Buy when out<0, Sell when out>0. No position closing on opposite signal - only SL/TP close positions.
python_conversion_notes: Neural network logic is straightforward to replicate: compute normalized BB ratios for 7 bars, dot-product with 14 weights (odd weights multiply zero inputs), multiply by 2, apply tanh. Key caveat: odd-indexed inputs[] are never populated, so only weights at even indices (w0,w2,w4,w6,w8,w10,w12) affect the output. Normalization uses min/max across all 7 bars of all three BB buffers. Digit adjustment logic (multiply SL/TP by 10 for 5/3-digit brokers) must be preserved. Position gate checks PositionSelect for same-side only (does not close opposite - only blocks new same-direction entry).
